fusions.name: Hoof Drum
fusions.desc: Drums your plates on the ground, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Hauling Charge
fusions.desc: Rolls a curled ball of scales into the first enemy it meets, dealing 15 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Tireless Stand
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 20 seconds. Enemies within 5 tiles are drawn onto you, up to 3, for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Plodding Pace
fusions.desc: You move 10% faster, and you have 8% physical resistance.
